source_audit.reference: performance33 archived N0 model and training protocol; no N1/local normalization
source_audit.reuse: LocalNorm checked paired-GPU controller/checkpoint/evaluation, photometric experiment isolated
source_audit.change: train-only joint affine data transform plus inverse prediction for original-coordinate MSE; no architecture changes
limits: Kaggle/private QB not executed during code preparation
photometric sensor response assumption may not hold exactly
no clipping deliberately permits out-of-range augmented input; actual raw data remain untouched
no full CUDA bitwise reproduction claim; old checkpoints cannot be resumed

conditions.normalization: DN/2047 only; provided LMS; no clipping; no N1/local normalization
conditions.loss: original DN/2047-coordinate MSE after undoing training affine prediction; no auxiliary loss
conditions.precision: AMP FP16 train; FP32 augmentation/inverse/loss/validation/test; TF32 off; GradScaler initial1024
conditions.augmentation_rng: independent CUDA Generator(seed+200000); same recorded plan in both arms; baseline applies identity
conditions.augmentation: train only; per-sample same scalar gain U[0.9,1.1),offset U[-0.01,0.01) for PAN/LMS/MS; no bandwise/spatial change
conditions.GT_policy: GT unchanged; inverse prediction (f(a*x+b)-b)/a compared to original GT; equivalent to transformed-GT MSE divided by a^2
conditions.inference: direct original model forward on unmodified inputs, no augmentation/inverse/TTA
conditions.selection: minimum full validation MSE including epoch0; earliest tie
conditions.baseline: archived33 N0, original RestoredPansharpeningNet, no reversible normalization
conditions.candidate: identical N0 network; only photometric training distribution differs
conditions.search: gain/offset intervals fixed before training; no sweep/select
conditions.test_policy: train/test each seed then next seed, settings frozen; no test tuning
conditions.metric_limitations: frozen33 metrics; RR Q2n/SCC and FR MATLAB/sensor MTF/phase parity unverified; FR no GT
